svg.title: One chat turn in sso-rag
svg.desc: ChatService starts the query rewriter in the background while the agent makes its first model call. The search tool waits for the rewriter's result, runs multi_search, then the agent writes the answer, which grounding.verify checks.
svg.text: Purple runs in the background on Llama; teal is the agent on Nova. Dashed = the handoff.
